build_patch_embeddings_for_vit: build a PatchEmbeddings module to construct CLS token, position and patch embeddings for a vision transformer
create_patch_embeddings_with_masking: create a PatchEmbeddings module with image masking enabled and a patch drop rate for training
run_forward_pass_patch_embeddings: run a forward pass through PatchEmbeddings with pixel values to get embeddings and optional mask outputs
review_PatchEmbeddingsOutput_namedtuple: review the PatchEmbeddingsOutput NamedTuple that holds embeddings, random mask, and ids restore tensors
test_PatchEmbeddings_2d_masking: test the PatchEmbeddings forward method with 2D patch drop rate tuple for dimension-wise random masking
